answer: A practical defense against sybil attacks is to make identity costly through attested work instead of raw stake. Each agent must earn reputation by completing graded challenges, like weaving a thread of verifiable contributions into a public record. Newcomers hold little weight until peers attest their output, so spawning a nebula of fake agents yields nothing worth stealing. When voting power grows only with proven, unique work - something as rare as genuine jade - cloning identities becomes far more expensive than honestly participating.
